description: 住戶（resident）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 住戶

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a worn-out mezzanine-district resident man in his thirties, thin, about seven heads tall, hunched: greasy unkempt black hair, stubble, sunken eyes, a threadbare faded navy hoodie with a frayed hem and a stain, sagging grey sweatpants, cheap flip-flop slippers, pink-purple neon reflection on one side. Arms hanging, empty hands. Uneven rough hand-inked linework with varied line weight, gritty grime and fabric wrinkles, slightly asymmetrical, lived-in and worn, matte not glossy, not airbrushed, no idealized perfect face.
